title: Boundary Battery
prompt: Implement all four checked operations. Adversarial extremes (INT_MAX, INT_MIN, empty vector, division by zero and INT_MIN/-1) must return nullopt — the naive versions are UB.

tests.name: addition and multiplication extremes
tests.hint: Pre-check with wider arithmetic or the guard identities: b>0&&a>INT_MAX-b for add; for mul, long long product then range-check (special-case INT_MIN*-1).

tests.name: bounds and division
tests.hint: atChecked: i >= v.size() -> nullopt. divChecked: b == 0 or (a == INT_MIN && b == -1) -> nullopt; C++ integer division truncates toward zero.
